regions.name: The Crossroads
regions.description: A leaning signpost, a cold brazier, and roads that all lead somewhere worse.

regions.name: Ashen Marsh
regions.description: Fog, iron, and things that breathe under the water.

regions.name: Whispering Woods
regions.description: Black pines that murmur your name a heartbeat before something does.

regions.name: Hollow Mine
regions.description: Abandoned shafts where the picks still ring at night.

regions.name: Drowned Chapel
regions.description: A sunken nave; the bell tolls underwater for a congregation that never left.

regions.name: Barrow Hills
regions.description: Grassy mounds over old kings who do not rest as well as they should.

regions.name: Grim Keep
regions.description: The fortress that named this land. Its gates are open. That is the worst sign.
